primary_route: Direct GSDMD N-terminal membrane action tested by purified protein/defined lipid reconstitution, orthogonal physical permeability and qualified mutant cellular rescue; conditional indirect-effector branch.

checks.quote: ## Recommended next action and decisive question
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of original Methods, supplements or validated protein/membrane/cell protocols to select and verify transferable conditions. Naming unknown settings and proposing local validation does not meet this separate lookup requirement.

checks.quote: Choose the initial range from protein stability and assay sensitivity.
checks.reason: The plan lists buffer, temperature, timing and electrophysiology settings but does not provide an operational pilot-to-choice rule for those settings. Qualitative stability/sensitivity guidance alone does not make these central assays executable.

checks.quote: Validate recording sensitivity and baseline membrane stability independently.
checks.reason: Good independent optical/electrical controls are present, but no objective calibration acceptance threshold or procedure mapping reference performance to pass/fail and repair is specified.

checks.quote: Use pilot data to set quantitative detection and decision thresholds.
checks.reason: Independent protein, vesicle and culture units are correct; no nuisance-variance-to-sample-size/precision or minimum-effect power plan justifies the amount of independent replication.

checks.quote: ## Recommended next action and decisive question
checks.reason: No prospective objective exclusion, attrition and stopping rules retain biological nonresponse while excluding technical failures; calling a condition ambiguous is not an exclusion ledger.

checks.quote: Independent sample number, effect-size threshold, and statistical analysis.
checks.reason: These are listed as future settings; the primary contrast/time window, statistical model, interval method and multiplicity handling are not specified.

checks.quote: Run a protein-concentration series and more than one lipid concentration.
checks.reason: No bounded candidate series or concrete range-derivation/stop rule for protein, lipid and physical assay settings is fixed before confirmation.

checks.quote: ## Recommended next action and decisive question

historical_match_reason: All five components are substantively present on the valid direct-action route. Question: "Test whether purified, liberated GSDMD amino-terminal domain can permeabilize a protein-free lipid bilayer." Mechanism: "Lose permeability-generating activity in minimal reconstitution." plus preserved folding/cleavage/localization and E activation. Intervention: purified full-length/N/C states, "A neutral-headgroup baseline" versus anionic panels and separation-of-function variants. Readout: "use vesicle flotation", "Appearance and latency of conductance", single-vesicle permeability/oligomerization and "Disruption plus wild-type full-length rescue." Outcome: "Strong evidence that direct membrane action contributes causally to cellular execution." Physical-pore evidence is appropriately qualified rather than claiming geometry from leakage. No critical control/inference failure invalidates this direction; M and operational omissions affect Q2. Round-one hit retained after rereading.
